sentences.en: Mechanic shot peening is a traditional process and widely employed by industrial circles.

sentences.en: Shot Peening ( SP ) is a typical severe plastic deformation method to produce ultra - fine grains of metallic materials.

sentences.en: Shot peening is also improved the stress relaxation ability of copper alloy.
